candidates.name: Unison
candidates.reason: Three deterministic canaries passed on 2026-10-15: exact search for Give It Up / Don Toliver, direct ID 31, and direct ID 1494 Love Never Felt So Good / Michael Jackson. Direct reads retained raw TTML; parsed tracks have 341/441 cues including explicit line and positioned word cues. Source attribution is https://unison.boidu.dev; individual lyric-text rights remain unverified and no ODbL claim is made.

candidates.name: Start Jamming
candidates.reason: Documented public read API; search has object/array response variants, index is keyed by ID, and artist can be absent. Chords use normalized measure arrays; cannot claim lyric-aligned chords. Requires a supported adapter and real canaries before activation. Primary API docs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-16 at 06:03:15 UTC. Agent requests to /api/songs/* must include for=agent, honor ETags and preserve canonical IDs/URLs. Agent responses omit license; licensing must not be inferred. Permitted reuse/attribution evidence and two independent live extraction canaries remain pending. Rechecked publisher API documentation on 2026-10-17 at 05:59:04 UTC: origin HTTP 200. On 2026-10-18 at 05:57 UTC, documented public search for Amazing Grace returned HTTP 200, exact canonical ID amazing-grace, canonical URL and API URL; agent response had no license field. Search success is one metadata identity check, not two independent extraction canaries or reuse permission. Still deferred pending rights/attribution, compatible adapter and complete canary coverage.

candidates.name: Lyrica
candidates.reason: Open-source self-hostable aggregator; repository documentation alone does not establish a supported public upstream service or independent data coverage. Investigate deployment/access requirements before proposing activation.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Wikisource
candidates.reason: On 2026-10-16 at 06:04:01 UTC, public MediaWiki siteinfo returned Ukrainian Wikisource (uk) and site CC BY-SA 4.0 rights metadata. At 06:04:12 UTC, the Ukrainian folk songs category returned five title metadata entries and continuation. This proves regional catalog metadata access only; no lyric extraction canaries were run. Overlap with existing sources is unmeasured. Defer pending per-work copyright/provenance review, attribution/share-alike handling, compatible identity/search adapter, two independent live extraction canaries and claimed capability coverage. Site rights metadata alone does not clear every work.

candidates.name: AMLL TTML Database
candidates.reason: Documented unauthenticated JSON search/get API. On 2026-10-17 at 05:57:03Z and 05:57:22Z, independent direct IDs 269710089745311 (ME!) and 638303942317135 (Shape of You) returned HTTP 200 and raw TTML with timed paragraphs/spans. Publisher describes the contributed database as CC0-1.0; retain project attribution and contributor usernames/IDs without extending that claim to every underlying work. Titles, artists and contributors are arrays; artist ordering varies and search can return multiple versions. Scalar/index-only extraction would lose contributors or misidentify collaborations. On 2026-10-18 at 05:56 UTC, documented direct ID 269710089745311 still returned HTTP 200 with TTML, arrays of titles/artists/contributors and raw document present. Same-time separate searches for Chinese 晴天 / 周杰伦 and Ukrainian Ой у вишневому саду / Софія Ротару returned zero matches each. Defer until a compatible adapter supports complete identities/provenance and repository canaries verify parsed cues and raw retention. Exact ID lookups are documented immutable. Overlap with existing timed sources remains unmeasured; this recheck does not establish Chinese or Ukrainian catalog coverage.

candidates.name: LrcShare API
candidates.reason: Publisher docs describe a niche manually curated catalog centered on Chinese rap, with original/translated/romanized lyrics in Chinese, Japanese, Korean and other languages, line/word timing formats, structured rows, metadata and per-version attribution. Quickstart says anonymous/no-key; lyric docs require X-API-Key and X-LrcShare-Session, and on 2026-10-18 at 05:57 UTC live GET requests to /v1/catalog and /v1/search returned HTTP 401 missing X-API-Key, so unauthenticated access was not verified and no credentials were requested. Publisher FAQ limits API use to noncommercial personal/local-library/player contexts; underlying lyric rights remain with rightsholders and the service disclaims ownership, so redistribution/display rights for Singbook remain uncleared. No live lyric extraction canaries or overlap assessment. Defer pending compatible identity/attribution and multilingual extraction support, eligible access, rights review, and two independent live canaries covering claimed capabilities.

candidates.name: Musixmatch
candidates.reason: Publisher documents track search and lyric retrieval with an API key and account/plan. No credential was requested, borrowed or provisioned by this unattended run. Defer pending eligible app access, current API/display/attribution terms, two independent live extraction canaries and claimed capability coverage. Expected overlap with existing broad catalogs is substantial but unmeasured; publisher API availability alone does not establish app redistribution permission.
